asset_spec.concept: Create a high-quality stylized vintage camera in native Blender Python with a layered lens, rounded manufactured body, leather grip panels, aged metal controls, fine rubber focus grip, studio HDRI lighting, and browser-ready export.

design_brief.concept: Create a high-quality stylized vintage camera in native Blender Python with a layered lens, rounded manufactured body, leather grip panels, aged metal controls, fine rubber focus grip, studio HDRI lighting, and browser-ready export.
intended_use: proof of automatic AmbientCG selection and R2 hydration

primary_shapes: layered circular lens projecting from the front
low top housing with two readable control dials
important_negative_spaces: separation between top dials and top housing
open centers in side strap lugs

proportions: body width is about 1.7 times body height
main lens diameter is about two thirds of body height
lens projects far enough to read in silhouette without overwhelming the body
top housing remains subordinate to the main body

parts.connection_strategy: Root structural body supporting every camera component.
parts.pivot_requirement: Origin centered on the camera body.

parts.connection_strategy: Sits slightly proud of the front body surface around the lens.
Centered on the front body and layered from mount to front glass.
parts.pivot_requirement: Lens optical axis through its center.

parts.connection_strategy: Bridges the lens barrel and camera body.

geometry_strategy: layered rounded frame and glass insert
parts.connection_strategy: Recessed into the upper front body.

material_slots.intent: Subtle black painted or powder-coated metal suitable for a vintage camera body; clean enough for a stylized product asset, with restrained micro-surface variation.
Warm medium-dark brown leather with fine grain appropriate to a handheld camera, not oversized furniture grain and not heavily damaged.
Warm aged brass or bronze mechanical hardware with controlled patina and readable highlights; not rusty structural steel.
Fine-grain matte black rubber appropriate to a camera focus ring, with restrained normal detail and no tire tread.
Dark coated metal for the lens barrel and small structural camera parts, slightly more metallic than the painted body and without obvious large scratches.

environment.intent: Soft neutral product-photography studio HDRI with broad highlights that reveal black paint, leather grain, brass, and lens glass.

acceptance_criteria: The camera reads immediately from the front three-quarter silhouette.
The lens contains at least five visibly stepped layers and recessed glass.
Leather, painted body metal, brass hardware, rubber, dark barrel metal, and glass remain visually distinct.
Manufactured edges are softened without making the camera toy-like.
The body and lens remain clean enough for browser export and inspection.
AmbientCG choices are selected automatically from semantic slot descriptions and prepared to R2 before Blender hydration.
benchmark_priorities: material scale appropriate to a small handheld object
